item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it on schedule is a small, repeatable act that supports everything else you're building. Your day already has steady anchors, so tie medication to one of them instead of relying on memory. Notice any gaps or doubts without judging yourself. If something isn't working, such as side effects or timing, note it and bring it to your prescriber. Action: attach your dose to your morning routine, starting today.
